title: Default generated Rust CLI: Dolt start helper (socket, logs) + per-tool isolated logical catalogs
intent: Batch-generated Rust CLIs ship a Dolt start path with standard socket, logs, and pid metadata. Each checkout uses .coherence/project.toml as the source of truth: project_slug is always set; project_hash is computed once from git rev-parse --show-toplevel and persisted; the effective MySQL database name is always derived by normalizing project_slug plus project_hash plus COHERENCE_ENV (dev test prod) so dev specs and test specs land in different logical databases. Explicit DOLT_DB remains an override for emergencies. Raw dolt_db_name alone is not the long-term contract.
expected_deliverable: Template emits Dolt start/stop matching standard socket and log paths
Template always generates .coherence/project.toml with project_slug; project init freezes project_hash via one git call
Template wires COHERENCE_ENV into catalog name resolution with documented defaults
Generated ConnectionConfig uses normalized catalog name when DOLT_DB unset
doctor/db-ping preflight verifies manifest completeness before connect
Optional auto-start behind explicit target only
Generator smoke: project init, start Dolt, migrate on fresh repo

Generated AGENTS.md includes manifest+env tier contract aligned with coherence-core-db: slug always for normal path, hash frozen after project init, COHERENCE_ENV selects normalized tier suffix, DOLT_DB override skips manifest preflight, shared preflight for db-ping/migrate/dolt-start when DOLT_DB unset

title: Template: preflight + isolated tests set COHERENCE_ENV=test
intent: Generated repos should fail fast with one remediation when manifest or hash is missing before Dolt connect. Automated tests that mutate catalog tables must run with COHERENCE_ENV=test (and existing isolated profile if any) so dev catalogs are never corrupted by default.
expected_deliverable: Shared preflight helper used by doctor db-ping migrate entry
with-isolated-test-profile or equivalent exports COHERENCE_ENV=test alongside any existing test profile env
Guard or naming rules ensure test runs target the test-normalized catalog not dev
AGENTS section documents dev vs test catalogs for generated CLI
Generator smoke covers missing-manifest error path

title: Generated Rust CLI: optional post-commit hook (debug build or ~/.local/bin install)
intent: Generated tools are often driven from a PATH-installed binary; developers forget to rebuild after commits. Ship the same opt-in git hook pattern as coherence-core-db: after each commit either run a fast incremental cargo build of the generated workspace crate or optionally make install-local-force to refresh INSTALL_ROOT/bin.
expected_deliverable: Template emits .githooks/post-commit executable; behavior matches coherence-core-db contract: GIT_HOOK_SKIP_COHERENCE_BUILD skips; default cargo build -p <generated-crate> --locked; optional install via git config coherence.postCommitInstallLocal and/or COHERENCE_POST_COMMIT_INSTALL_LOCAL truthy env
Hook uses template placeholders for crate path/package name and Makefile install targets (not hard-coded coherence-core-db unless demo name is intentional)
Generated AGENTS.md section documents git config core.hooksPath .githooks, both modes, and that install-local-force is slower
Generator smoke or release checklist asserts hook file exists and is executable in emitted tree
